description: Scans an EVM wallet address across all supported lending protocols and returns every active borrowing position with health factors and liquidation risk. Covers Aave V3 (7 chains: Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Optimism, Avalanche, Scroll), Aave V4 (Ethereum Core/Prime/Plus), Spark (Ethereum), Morpho (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum), Euler (Ethereum, Monad), and Moonwell (Base, Optimism). Health factor < 1.0 means the position is liquidatable. Use this when asked: "Is this wallet at risk of liquidation?", "Show all lending positions for 0x…", "Which protocols is this wallet borrowing from?", "Which of these wallets is closest to liquidation?"

wallet.description: EVM wallet address — must start with 0x and be exactly 42 characters, e.g. 0xabc…1234

name: scan_wallet

positions.description: Active borrowing positions per protocol and chain

healthFactor.description: Health factor, null if not available

totalPositions.description: Total active borrowing positions found across all protocols

title: Scan EVM Wallet
